scope: offline only; a learned trial-level proxy for HPO and append-only meta feature selection. It cannot modify a live model, score, map, admission, or portfolio.

canonical_control.current: 0.75 Base rank + 0.25 frozen Under F120 rank
canonical_control.policy: canonical rich 15-minute policy net bps; 100 bps cost embedded once

trial_contract: A trial is one replacement candidate for the existing Under F120 meta slot. It uses all 120 frozen parent fields plus an optional append-only field subset. It never creates a new head.

frozen_downstream_contract.mc1: independent Current and BCF six-complete-calendar-month packages with their frozen model/HPO and prior-21-day resolved-outcome shift
frozen_downstream_contract.priority_value: matched admission-budget Top1/Top2 EV, candidate substitution EV, captured utility, weekly lower-tail stability
frozen_downstream_contract.gate_value: real dual Current/BCF >=50 bps admitted EV/trade, admitted utility, >=50 and >100 precision, volume, and stability
frozen_downstream_contract.portfolio_value: separate later confirmation under the fixed chronological constrained auction; never the only training target

round_1.representative_sampling: stratify across target family, target geometry, loss, HPO class, sample-weight profile, and feature contract; include good, mediocre, and bad cheap diagnostics
round_1.noise_adjustment: block-bootstrap or week/month standard errors; shrink/weight downstream labels by reliability

surrogates.name: P3_pairwise
surrogates.purpose: rank whether one trial has greater downstream value than another

proxy_validation: Spearman predicted vs realized downstream value

selection.hpo_rule: maximize PriorityProxy subject to GateProxy >= frozen-control tolerance, residual IC floor, and weekly-Q10 floor
selection.acquisition: top predicted 10 + high uncertainty 5 + diverse controls 5, using prediction + kappa * uncertainty
selection.feature_rule: add, drop, and swap fields by Delta predicted downstream MC1 value; validate top 3-5 feature contracts with actual MC1
selection.promotion: Only complete matched MC1/admission/portfolio evidence may promote a candidate; the learned proxy has no direct model-score authority.

causality: Every descriptor is derived only after a strict target-free held score has been persisted. Every MC1 label uses only policy outcomes resolved before its held vintage.
